name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 👥 My club is in sections by job: Club news, Secretary, Licenses and dues, Club numbers, Swarm team, Officers and admin. Tap a heading to open it, or pick one from Jump to at the top.
🎖️ Club leaders are now called officers.
🪣 Hives list: Sort by hive type.
✏️ Hive and yard names have a length limit, so they fit on the phone's screen.
🗣️ Say "double screened board" (or "double screen board"). Just "double screen" and Buddy asks which you meant; a door said without the board, Buddy asks too.

✅ Meeting check-in, with no cell service: in 👥 My club, members tap ✅ Check in. They show their own code to the secretary, or scan the meeting's code on the secretary's phone or a printed card on the table.

🚪 Club secretaries: 📋 Member list › Check people in. Scan members' codes, tap names, add visitors, show the meeting code, or print the table card. It's all kept on the phone and sent when there's service.
📶 My club opens with no service too, from what the phone kept last time.
🔤 Check people in: sort the names by first or last name, and tap a letter A to Z to jump there. On an iPad or computer the names show in columns.
📷 Scanning a check-in code: a green box says it worked, a red one says why not. Code won't scan? Tap 🙋 Show my code to the secretary instead.
🛟 Club officers: if your club's other admin is gone, ask for them to be replaced from their row in 👥 Roles.
🍬 Candy boards: three more recipes (sugar bricks, Mountain Camp and fondant).
🚚 A new pallet on the yard map goes on open ground, never hidden under other hives.
🗣️ Buddy understands more: honey counts like "four full and two half", oxalic acid said many ways, moving hives and pallets by voice, and a sentence the phone cut off is asked again.
🔔 Your turn to answer now has the same rising sound as when listening starts.
